5923.body:
Heeding the Call Speak with  Mathrengyl Bearwalker  in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.  
  
  


 Description Excuse me, friend...

It has come to my attention that  Mathrengyl Bearwalker  has put out word that he wishes to speak with you.  It seems that your training as a druid is about to take on a new life, and he will be training you personally.  Mathrengyl is the direct assistant to the Arch Druid himself, and is one of the most sage and august druids you'll find in Teldrassil.

He is located in the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus, on the second floor of Fandral Staghelm's tree.  Completion   I'm glad you found your way here today, young <class>.  The time has come for you to take a large step into a much larger world.

Inside each of Cenarius' children is the call to serve nature.  Animals and plants are our friends as well as our charges.  We choose to devote our lives as preservers of balance for their sakes as well as our own.  Your first step into this world will be to learn of the ways of the bear, and to learn strength of body and heart.

Ready yourself! 

 Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

 
     Open in Experience Calculator      25  reputation with  Cenarion Circle    

         
        See if you've already completed this by typing:

         /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(5923))

94911.body:
Child of Nature Speak with  Turak Runetotem  in Thunder Bluff.  
  
  


 Description Greetings, young <race>. I can see that you have much promise in the druidic arts. There is one who you may want to speak with in the city of Thunder Bluff by the name of  Turak Runetotem . He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, Moonglade. 

You will be welcomed there, and the druids of the circle will impart their knowledge upon you. 

As your people would say--go with the wind's blessing, young one. I wish you good fortune in your adventures.  Completion   A high elf, speaking to me... in Thunder Bluff. Will wonders never cease?

Well, shaper of wind, let me join our Earthen Ring brothers and sisters in welcoming you to Azeroth. My fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature. 

 Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

 
     Open in Experience Calculator      100  reputation with  Nightclaw Druids    

         
        See if you've already completed this by typing:

         /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(94911))

94912.body:
Child of Nature Speak with  Sheldras Moontree  in Stormwind.  
  
  


 Description Greetings, young <class>. 

Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of  Sheldras Moontree . He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.

Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.  Completion   Greetings, fellow <class>. It pleases me to meet a fellow <class> from among the Skyborne, and to be among the first to welcome you to Azeroth.

I think you will find that my fellow druids of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.

94913.body:
Moonglade Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with  Dendrite Starblaze  in the village of Nighthaven.  
  
  


 Description All druids are welcomed to the sacred lands of Moonglade. Keeper Remulos--Moonglade's guardian--keeps watch over all druids who hibernate there. I'll teach you the spell that lets you transport yourself there. Cast it whenever you seek Moonglade's knowledge or solace.

As for your first lesson here on Azeroth, travel to Moonglade and speak with  Dendrite Starblaze  in Nighthaven about the path you're now on. Good luck, young druid.  Completion   Ah I see that you have already mastered the form of the Bear. Good, good. You are well on your way, young <class>.

98340.body:
The Great Cat Spirit Speak with  Dendrite Starblaze  in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.  
  
  


 Description It would seem that you are ready for the next step in your journey, young druid.  Dendrite Starblaze  has sent for you, and wishes for you to seek him out in Moonglade once again.

You have already learned to call upon the magic to take you to Moonglade, so you should be able to embark immediately if you choose. I would suggest you leave soon, if you wish to continue your druidic training.  Completion   And so it continues, Father Cenarius.

<Dendrite makes a quick, invisible gesture in the air above him. A slight aura of power falls over him.>

Greetings again, <name>. It is time for you to learn the next perspective of nature: the cat. I will put you on the path to understanding this aspect of druidic life, but much like the bear, it is you that must embrace this learning and propagate it.

98405.body:
The Great Cat Spirit Seek out the  Great Cat Spirit  in southern part Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the cat.  
  
  


 Description In the southern part of Moonglade, on a hill overlooking the bridge, resides a wise and cunning being we call the  Great Cat Spirit .

Much like the Great Bear Spirit, this spirit has served as a tutor and mentor to druids that desire to take the feline shape. All druids eventually seek its wisdom, and if you desire to take the form of a cat, you will as well.

Go meet with the  Great Cat Spirit  and learn what it will teach you.  Completion   I see you have come to learn to draw upon my spirit. Good. Let us see if you are ready to take my shape. 

 Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

 
     Open in Experience Calculator      50  reputation with  Cenarion Circle    

         
        See if you've already completed this by typing:

         /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(98405))

98342.body:
The Great Cat Spirit Recover the  Relic of the Fang ,  Relic of the Claw , and  Relic of the Silent Shadow  from the Stormrage Barrow Den, and return them to the  Great Cat Spirit . 
     Relic of the Fang   ( 1 )   
     Relic of the Claw   ( 1 )   
     Relic of the Silent Shadow   ( 1 )   
 



  
  
  


 Description To draw upon my spirit, you will need more than a few words. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.

In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics of my favor you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.

Return these relics to me. We will see if you are ready to take my shape.  Progress   Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you? 

  Completion   Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.

I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young <class>. 

 Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

 
     Open in Experience Calculator      50  reputation with  Cenarion Circle    

         
        See if you've already completed this by typing:

         /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(98342))
98342.reviewed: all five field boundaries inspected; reward/objective tables and scripts excluded; no removed-description/self-training marker

98739.body:
Blessings of the Great Cat Spirit Speak to Dendrite.  
  
  


 Description Now that you have received my blessing, return to Dendrite. He will instruct you further. I do hope we meet again someday.

May the shadows forever hide you and your foes easily fall prey to your claws, young one.  Completion   <Dendrite makes another invisible gesture in the air above him as you approach. Another aura of power comes over him, and he smiles ever so slightly.>

I sense the cunning and ferocity of the cat within you that was not present when I sent you to meet the  Great Cat Spirit . In your eyes I can sense you now understand the stealth and speed needed to adopt this nature.

Now you may learn to focus your cunning and adopt the true nature of the cat and call upon its spirit. 

 Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

 
     Open in Experience Calculator      50  reputation with  Cenarion Circle    

         
        See if you've already completed this by typing:

         /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(98739))

98362.body:
To Thunder Bluff Return to Thunder Bluff and speak with  Turak Runetotem  on the Elder Rise.  
  
  


 Description The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to the one who sent you to me. It would seem your instructor,  Turak Runetotem , has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.

Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.  Completion   Welcome back, <name>. I can sense you have met with the Great Cat Spirit and have successfully completed the trial. All druids must pass a trial given by this spirit, though the trials vary by generation. I am proud you have passed and have heeded the wisdom of the Great Cat Spirit. It is an ancient spirit that is as deadly as it is playful, though I can sense you understand the spirit's nature already.

I will now instruct you on how to take the shape of the cat. 

 Rewards You will learn:

 
     Cat Form  
  



 Gains Upon completion of this quest you will gain:

 
     Open in Experience Calculator    

         
        See if you've already completed this by typing:

         /run print(C_QuestLog.IsQuestFlaggedCompleted(98362))
